![](alpaca.jpeg){.profile-pic}

I lead [LAMALab](https://lamalab.org/) at Friedrich Schiller University Jena.

Chemistry's working concepts — oxidation state, aromaticity, strain — were nearly all defined on idealised structures, because that was the only way to compute anything. We are trying to rebuild them on what instruments record, and on what a chemist actually does next: [actionable understanding](research.qmd) rather than a better prediction.

[Research](research.qmd) · [Bio](bio.qmd) · [Email](https://mailhide.io/e/o4LeOUlq) · [Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=R2ntI8IAAAAJ&hl=en) · [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/kjablonka.com)

The lab is [hiring](https://lamalab.org/).
